Container.Name: no-alias-invoices
Container.Overview:
Local invoice generator with saved recipients, venues and PDF history.
INVOICE PDF FOLDER Completed invoices are also saved as number-first PDFs, for example LEA0169 Invoice.pdf. Set Invoice PDF folder to the Unraid folder where you want the copies. It maps to /data/invoices in the container and must be writable. Draft previews are not copied. Existing installations without this extra mapping save copies under their Appdata folder in an invoices subfolder; add a Path mapping to /data/invoices to choose another location.
BUSINESS NAME Enter your business name in the Business name field. It appears at the top of the web UI and on new invoices. Leave blank to use the business name saved in the app.
COMPANY LOGO - LOCAL FILE (EASIEST) Copy a PNG or JPEG into the host folder configured under Appdata. For the default mapping, /mnt/user/appdata/no-alias-invoices/logo.png on Unraid is /data/logo.png inside the container. Enter /data/logo.png in Company logo. If using a different Appdata folder, copy the image into that folder and still enter /data/logo.png. File names are case-sensitive.
COMPANY LOGO - ANOTHER SHARE To keep your logo elsewhere, choose Add another Path, Port, Variable, Label or Device, select Path, set Host Path to your logo folder, Container Path to /logos, and Access Mode to Read Only. Then enter /logos/logo.png in Company logo. Do not enter the Unraid host path directly unless it has been mapped to the same container path.
COMPANY LOGO - URL Alternatively, enter a direct HTTP(S) URL to a PNG or JPEG accessible from the container. Logos must be at most 10 MB and 20 million pixels. Leave Company logo blank to preserve the logo already in your private Word template.
Click Apply, open the WebUI and generate a draft PDF to check the result. These settings affect new PDFs; saved invoices are unchanged. Docker Icon URL is separate and controls only the icon in Unraid's Docker list.
INVOICE EMAIL Configure the optional SMTP variables to send final PDF invoices to saved contact email addresses. TLS is required: starttls (usually 587) or ssl (usually 465). Leave passwords blank in shared templates. On New invoice select Email invoice to contact; check History for delivery status. The app remains local-only with no login: keep it on your trusted LAN or VPN.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Settings, invoices and optional private template

Config.Name: Invoice PDF folder
Config.Description: Folder for completed invoice PDFs, named LEA0169 Invoice.pdf. Must be writable. Draft previews are not copied.

Config.Name: Business name
Config.Description: Business name shown at the top of the web UI and on new invoices. Blank uses existing app settings.

Config.Name: Company logo
Config.Description: PNG/JPEG HTTP(S) URL or container path, e.g. /data/logo.png. Blank preserves the Word template logo.

Config.Name: SMTP host
Config.Description: Mail server hostname. Blank disables invoice email.

Config.Name: SMTP port
Config.Description: Mail server port, normally 587 for STARTTLS or 465 for SSL.

Config.Name: SMTP security
Config.Description: starttls or ssl. Unencrypted SMTP is not supported.

Config.Name: SMTP username
Config.Description: Mail account username. Use an app password where required.

Config.Name: SMTP sender
Config.Description: Single sender email address permitted by your mail provider.
